import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from robot import tools, target, handoff, docs, ToolRefused
from ora_lib import current, geometry as G
import geo

arm, bname, wname = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
obs = current()
bx, by, ztop = geo.bottle_axis(geo.BOTTLES[bname], obs)
wx, wy, rimz, rr = geo.bowl_info(geo.BOWLS[wname], obs)
pose_now = obs.pose(arm)
q_now = [float(v) for v in pose_now.xyzw]
print("bottle", bname, "axis", round(bx,4), round(by,4), "top", round(ztop,4),
      "| bowl", wname, round(wx,4), round(wy,4), "rim", round(rimz,4), "r", round(rr,4))
print("arm", arm, "pos", np.round(pose_now.xyz,4).tolist(), "quat", np.round(q_now,4).tolist())

GZ, APP = 0.86, geo.JAW_CENTRE_ALONG_APPROACH
p_grasp = [bx, by - APP, GZ]
p_pre   = [bx, by - APP - 0.12, GZ + 0.06]

def tgt(p, interaction):
    return {arm: {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": [float(v) for v in p],
                  "orientation_mode": "hold_current", "interaction": interaction}}

# --- plan check (read-only) ---
for name, p, it in (("pregrasp", p_pre, "free_space"), ("grasp", p_grasp, "precision")):
    pl = tools.move_pose(targets=tgt(p, it), dry_run=True)
    print("dry", name, "feasible", pl.feasible, "code", pl.failure_code, "|", pl.summary[:160])
    if not pl.feasible:
        handoff("approach path not feasible", stage=name, code=pl.failure_code, summary=pl.summary)

# --- act ---
r = tools.move_pose(targets=tgt(p_pre, "free_space"))
print("pregrasp", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok: handoff("pregrasp move failed", status=r.status, code=r.failure_code)
r = tools.move_pose(targets=tgt(p_grasp, "precision"))
print("approach", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok: handoff("grasp approach failed", status=r.status, code=r.failure_code)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "close"})
print("close", r.status, r.ok, "opening_norm", r.measured_opening, r.gripper_command)
closed_opening = r.measured_opening
r = tools.move_pose(targets=tgt([p_grasp[0], p_grasp[1], p_grasp[2] + 0.08], "precision"))
print("lift", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok: handoff("lift failed", status=r.status, code=r.failure_code)

# --- verify: bottle base left the table ---
obs2 = current()
cam = obs2.camera("head")
pts = G.mask_to_cloud(np.asarray(cam.depth_m), np.asarray(cam.K), np.ones_like(np.asarray(cam.depth_m), bool))
w = G.transform_points(pts, np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world))
box = (np.abs(w[:,0]-bx) < 0.035) & (np.abs(w[:,1]-by) < 0.030) & (w[:,2] > 0.785) & (w[:,2] < 0.845)
n_low = int(box.sum())
p_after = obs2.pose(arm)
print("verify: points where bottle base stood (z .785-.845):", n_low,
      "| arm now", np.round(p_after.xyz,4).tolist())
print("grasp opening norm", closed_opening)
if n_low > 20:
    handoff("bottle still on table after lift", n_low=n_low)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "close"})
print("re-close check", r.status, "opening", r.measured_opening)
print("OK")

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from robot import tools, handoff, query, ToolRefused
from ora_lib import current
import geo

arm, bname, wname = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
obs = current()
p_now = obs.pose(arm)
p6 = np.array(p_now.xyz); R = Rot.from_quat(p_now.xyzw).as_matrix()
bw = geo.bowl_now(obs, wname)
if bw is None: handoff("bowl not found", wname=wname)
wx, wy, rimz = bw["x"], bw["y"], bw["rim_z"]
bb = geo.bottle_now(obs, bname)
if bb is None: handoff("held bottle not found", bname=bname)
neck_w = np.array([bb["x"], bb["y"], bb["ztop"]])
v_hand = R.T @ (neck_w - p6)
print("bowl", np.round([wx,wy,rimz],4), "| neck", np.round(neck_w,4), "| v_hand", np.round(v_hand,4))
if not (0.13 < v_hand[0] < 0.17 and 0.09 < v_hand[2] < 0.16) or abs(v_hand[1]) > 0.02:
    handoff("held bottle transform implausible", v_hand=v_hand.tolist())

axis_roll = R @ np.array([1.0,0,0])
NEED = 0.86
stages = [(120.0, NEED), (140.0, 0.85), (155.0, 0.845), (165.0, 0.845)]
poses = []
for th, nz in stages:
    Rt = Rot.from_rotvec(axis_roll*np.radians(th)).as_matrix() @ R
    poses.append(geo.pose_of(Rt, np.array([wx, wy, nz]) - Rt @ v_hand))
r = query("reach_check", arm=arm, poses=[p for p in poses])
oks = [x["reachable"] for x in r.get("results", [])]
print("reach", oks, [x.get("reason") for x in r.get("results", [])])
if not all(oks): handoff("tilt stage unreachable", oks=oks)

def tgt(p):
    return {arm: {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": [float(x) for x in p[:3]],
                  "orientation_mode": "absolute_quaternion", "orientation_xyzw": [float(x) for x in p[3:]],
                  "interaction": "precision"}}

pl = tools.move_pose(targets=tgt(poses[0]), dry_run=True)
print("dry first tilt:", pl.feasible, "|", pl.summary[:200])
if not pl.feasible: handoff("first tilt not plannable", code=pl.failure_code, summary=pl.summary)

for (th, nz), pz in zip(stages, poses):
    r = tools.move_pose(targets=tgt(pz))
    print(f"tilt {th}: {r.status} ok={r.ok} err={r.target_error_m}")
    if not r.ok: handoff("tilt failed", th=th, status=r.status, code=r.failure_code)
    for _ in range(2):
        rw = tools.wait_ticks(ticks=20)
        if not rw.ok: print("wait issue", rw.status)
print("pour stages done")

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current
from ora_lib import geometry as G
import geo

arm, bname, wname = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
BOWL = {"brown": (-0.1506,-0.1499,0.8055), "black": (-0.0018,-0.1499,0.8055), "white": (0.1487,-0.1497,0.8053)}
BOT  = {"red": (-0.2009,-0.0003), "violet": (-0.0010,-0.0003), "turq": (0.1981,-0.0003)}
obs = current()
p_now = obs.pose(arm)
p6 = np.array(p_now.xyz); R = Rot.from_quat(p_now.xyzw).as_matrix()
st = __import__("json").load(open(f"/work/state_{bname}.json"))
v_hand = np.array(st["v_hand"])
wx, wy, rimz = BOWL[wname]
bx, by = BOT[bname]
BOTTLE_H = 0.2182
axis_roll = R @ np.array([1.0,0,0])
print("now", np.round(p6,4), "v_hand", np.round(v_hand,4))

def tgt(p, interaction="precision"):
    return {arm: {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": [float(x) for x in p[:3]],
                  "orientation_mode": "absolute_quaternion", "orientation_xyzw": [float(x) for x in p[3:]],
                  "interaction": interaction}}

steps = []
# 1) unwind to horizontal, mouth still over the bowl
Rt = Rot.from_rotvec(axis_roll*np.radians(-90)).as_matrix() @ R
steps.append(("unwind90", tgt(geo.pose_of(Rt, np.array([wx,wy,0.98]) - Rt @ v_hand))))
# 2) upright, mouth still over the bowl  (the judged moment)
Rt = Rot.from_rotvec(axis_roll*np.radians(-165)).as_matrix() @ R
up = Rt
steps.append(("upright", tgt(geo.pose_of(Rt, np.array([wx,wy,1.05]) - Rt @ v_hand))))
# 3) carry upright over its own spot, 4) lower, 5) open, 6) retreat
steps.append(("carry", tgt(geo.pose_of(up, np.array([bx, by-0.1501, 1.02])), "free_space")))
steps.append(("lower", tgt(geo.pose_of(up, np.array([bx, by-0.1501, 0.86])))))
for name, t in steps:
    pl = tools.move_pose(targets=t, dry_run=True)
    print("dry", name, pl.feasible, pl.failure_code, "|", (pl.summary or "")[:100])
    if not pl.feasible: handoff("unwind/setdown step not plannable", step=name, code=pl.failure_code)
for name, t in steps:
    r = tools.move_pose(targets=t)
    print(name, r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, round(float(r.target_error_m or 0),5))
    if not r.ok: handoff("set-down step failed", step=name, code=r.failure_code, status=r.status)
    if name in ("unwind90", "upright"): tools.wait_ticks(ticks=10)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"})
print("open", r.status, r.ok, r.measured_opening)
r = tools.move_pose(targets=tgt(geo.pose_of(up, np.array([bx-0.08, by-0.30, 1.02])), "free_space"))
print("retreat", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code)

# verify bottle standing at its spot, and bowl fill
obs2 = current()
cam = obs2.camera("head"); d = np.asarray(cam.depth_m); K=np.asarray(cam.K); T=np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world)
h,w_ = d.shape
u,v = np.meshgrid(np.arange(w_), np.arange(h))
pc = np.stack([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0], (v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1], d], -1).reshape(-1,3)
pw = pc @ T[:3,:3].T + T[:3,3]
sv = (np.abs(pw[:,0]-bx)<0.04)&(np.abs(pw[:,1]-by)<0.04)&(pw[:,2]>0.90)&(pw[:,2]<1.05)
print("bottle standing points near spot z>0.9:", int(sv.sum()), "max z", round(float(pw[sv][:,2].max()),4) if sv.sum() else None)
sb = (np.abs(pw[:,0]-wx)<0.034)&(np.abs(pw[:,1]-wy)<0.034)&(pw[:,2]>0.771)&(pw[:,2]<0.83)
zs = pw[sb][:,2]
print("bowl interior: n", zs.size, "median z", round(float(np.median(zs)),4) if zs.size else None)
# spill check: table-level points between the bowl and the robot that are above the table
ss = (pw[:,2]>0.770)&(pw[:,2]<0.800)&(np.abs(pw[:,0]-wx)<0.18)&(np.abs(pw[:,1]-wy)<0.18)
print("points 0.770-0.800 within 18cm of bowl:", int(ss.sum()))

from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current
import geo

arm, bname, wname = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
obs = current()
p_now = obs.pose(arm)
p6 = np.array(p_now.xyz); R = Rot.from_quat(p_now.xyzw).as_matrix()
v_hand = np.array(json.load(open(f"/work/state_{bname}.json"))["v_hand"])
wx, wy, rimz, wr = geo.BOWL_FIXED[wname]
bx, by, _ = geo.BOTTLE_START[bname]
axis_roll = R @ np.array([1.0,0,0])
print("now", np.round(p6,4), "v_hand", np.round(v_hand,4), "| bottle spot", (bx,by), "bowl", (wx,wy,rimz))

def tgt(p, interaction="precision"):
    return {arm: {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": [float(x) for x in p[:3]],
                  "orientation_mode": "absolute_quaternion", "orientation_xyzw": [float(x) for x in p[3:]],
                  "interaction": interaction}}

Rt90 = Rot.from_rotvec(axis_roll*np.radians(-90)).as_matrix() @ R
Rt0  = Rot.from_rotvec(axis_roll*np.radians(-165)).as_matrix() @ R
up = Rt0
steps = [
  ("unwind90", tgt(geo.pose_of(Rt90, np.array([wx,wy,0.98]) - Rt90 @ v_hand))),
  ("upright",  tgt(geo.pose_of(Rt0,  np.array([wx,wy,1.05]) - Rt0 @ v_hand))),
  ("carry",    tgt(geo.pose_of(up, np.array([bx, by-0.1501, 1.02])), "free_space")),
  ("lower",    tgt(geo.pose_of(up, np.array([bx, by-0.1501, geo.GRASP_GZ])))),
  ("retreat",  tgt(geo.pose_of(up, np.array([bx-0.08, by-0.30, 1.02])), "free_space")),
]
for name, t in steps:
    pl = tools.move_pose(targets=t, dry_run=True)
    print("dry", name, pl.feasible, pl.failure_code, "|", (pl.summary or "")[:90])

from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot

from ora_lib import current

arm, bname, wname = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]

wx, wy, rimz, wr = geo.BOWL_FIXED[wname]
bb = geo.bottle_now(obs, bname)
if bb is None: handoff("held bottle not grounded", bname=bname)
neck_w = np.array([bb["x"], bb["y"], bb["ztop"]])
v_hand = R.T @ (neck_w - p6)
print("bowl", np.round([wx,wy,rimz],4), "| neck", np.round(neck_w,4), "| v_hand", np.round(v_hand,4))
if not (0.12 < v_hand[0] < 0.18 and 0.09 < v_hand[2] < 0.16 and abs(v_hand[1]) < 0.03):
    handoff("held bottle transform implausible", v_hand=v_hand.tolist())
json.dump({"v_hand": v_hand.tolist(), "arm": arm, "grasp_R": R.tolist()}, open(f"/work/state_{bname}.json","w"))

axis_roll = R @ np.array([1.0,0,0])
stages = [(120.0, 0.86), (140.0, 0.85), (155.0, 0.845), (165.0, 0.845)]
poses = []
for th, nz in stages:
    Rt = Rot.from_rotvec(axis_roll*np.radians(th)).as_matrix() @ R
    poses.append(geo.pose_of(Rt, np.array([wx,wy,nz]) - Rt @ v_hand))
r = query("reach_check", arm=arm, poses=poses)
print("reach", [(x["reachable"], x.get("reason")) for x in r.get("results", [])])
if not all(x["reachable"] for x in r.get("results", [])): handoff("tilt unreachable")

                  "orientation_mode": "absolute_quaternion", "orientation_xyzw": [float(x) for x in p[3:]],
                  "interaction": "precision"}}
pl = tools.move_pose(targets=tgt(poses[0]), dry_run=True)
print("dry tilt120", pl.feasible, pl.failure_code, "|", (pl.summary or "")[:120])
if not pl.feasible: handoff("first tilt not plannable", code=pl.failure_code)
for (th, nz), pz in zip(stages, poses):
    rr = tools.move_pose(targets=tgt(pz))
    print(f"tilt {th}: {rr.status} ok={rr.ok} err={rr.target_error_m}")
    if not rr.ok: handoff("tilt failed", th=th, code=rr.failure_code)
    tools.wait_ticks(ticks=20); tools.wait_ticks(ticks=20)
print("pour stages done")

obs = current()

wx, wy, rimz, wr = geo.BOWL_FIXED[wname]

# park the other arm out of the way
park_candidates = [(-0.28,-0.28,1.12), (-0.30,-0.20,1.10), (-0.35,-0.30,1.05)]
park = None
for pc in park_candidates:
    rc = query("reach_check", arm=other, poses=[list(pc)+[float(x) for x in obs.pose(other).xyzw]])
    if rc["results"][0]["reachable"]:
        t = {other: {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": list(pc),

        pl = tools.move_pose(targets=t, dry_run=True)
        print("park", pc, "feasible", pl.feasible, pl.failure_code, "|", (pl.summary or "")[:90])

            park = t; break

obs = current()

    tools.wait_ticks(ticks=20); tools.wait_ticks(ticks=20)
print("done")
